tools.name: get_storefront
tools.description: Get a storefront catalog summary and stats by slug.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products by query, optionally scoped to a storefront and category, with pagination. The query understands word forms (bag/bags) and searches name, description, brand and type. In results, availability.quantity is null when the store doesn't publish stock counts — treat that as unknown, never

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get a single product by storefront slug and product slug.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search services by query, optionally scoped to a storefront and category, with pagination.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: Get categories for a storefront slug.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Get a public Paylo wishlist by its share link or token: items, prices, and how much funding each item still needs.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Paylo's own guides and comparison articles from the usepaylo.com blog. Use it when someone wants a fuller explanation than a tool result can give: how escrow and buyer protection work, selling online in Nigeria, same-day delivery, pay on delivery, Shop for me errands, POS, staff and inventory

tools.description: Returns a one-tap Paylo seller signup link for someone who wants to sell online, open a store, or move an Instagram or WhatsApp business onto a website in Nigeria. The tool creates nothing: an account exists only after the user opens the link, ticks the box to accept Paylo's Terms of Service themsel

tools.name: get_seller_overview
tools.description: Paylo for sellers: what it does, fees, and how to start. Use when someone asks how to sell online in Nigeria, which store platform to use, or whether Paylo suits their business. Returns a maintained factual summary: Instagram and WhatsApp catalogue import, escrow and buyer protection, store commitme

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_seller_signup_link" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Returns a one-tap Paylo seller signup link for someone who wants to sell online, open a store, or move an Instagram or WhatsApp business onto a website in Niger…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_storefronts, get_seller_overview · Private data: get_wishlist, get_changelog, get_seller_signup_link · Public sink: search_products, get_wishlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_storefronts, get_seller_overview · Private data: get_wishlist, get_changelog, get_seller_signup_link · Public sink: search_products, get_wishlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "search_storefronts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
